'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Mike Richards LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Deck name:''' WTF... Panic?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
